title: Three source labels now distinguish a company webpage and council item history from technical reports
summary: An exact-URL review corrected one Current Applications and two Toronto research-record labels. Two other Toronto records already had the appropriate local-government label and remain unchanged. Source publishers, narrative claims, original records and downloads, dates, statuses and project decisions are preserved.
evidence_note: The exact company home page and City Council item-history page were read for artifact type only. This does not establish company performance, enactment, permits, a new evidence decision or independent acceptance. The September 28 Toronto appointment is unchanged. Current cards, filters and exports use the corrected label; historical archives remain historical.
publication_effect: Current artifact-type labels corrected; original publication states and dates unchanged. No release or independent review approval.
